description: Returns a report finish_audit or run_audit wrote, so it can be read without access to the computer running this server. part markdown (default): report.md, the verdict, findings, consent and journeys in about 120 lines. summary: summary.json, the counts, journeys and findings as JSON. timeline: one JSON entry per step of each journey (hits with their consent, consent commands, the Google tag's consent, cookies and ids, the Google containers loaded). containers: every GTM container and Google tag the journeys loaded as JSON, with how each reached the page (source html, inline, script, custom_html, google_tag, nested, config, send_to or destination, and by: the container or script that loaded it), its dataLayer, host, GTM environment, version, size, load time and pages. widgets: every embedded third-party widget as JSON: where it was embedded, the containers it loaded, the tracking it sent to its own accounts and to the site's, its own dataLayer events, and the events it pushed that never reached the site's accounts (unshared).

report.description: The report name finish_audit or run_audit gave.

name: get_report
title: Read a report this server wrote
